faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, bank transfers, and purchase orders from verified healthcare institutions. For large orders, we also offer financing options.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days within the continental US. Express shipping (2-3 business days) and overnight options are available at checkout. International shipping times vary by destination, usually 7-14 business days.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranties on your products?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our medical equipment comes with manufacturer warranties ranging from 1-5 years depending on the product. We also offer extended warranty options for additional peace of mind. Please check individual product pages for specific warranty information.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange a product?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for unused products in their original packaging. Custom or personalized items may have different return conditions. Please contact our customer service team to initiate a return or exchange.

faqs.question: Do you provide product training or support?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We provide comprehensive product training through video tutorials, user manuals, and live webinars. Our technical support team is available Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM EST to assist with any questions or issues.

faqs.question: Are your products FDA approved?
faqs.answer: Yes, all medical devices we sell are FDA cleared or approved as required. We only partner with manufacturers who meet strict regulatory standards and maintain proper certifications for their products.

faqs.question: Do you offer bulk or wholesale pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer competitive pricing for bulk orders and have special programs for dental practices, hospitals, and educational institutions. Please contact our sales team or request a quote for volume discounts.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with tracking information. You can also log into your account on our website to view order status and tracking details in real-time.
